purpose: Relax all competing closed-shell XY2 relational-state seeds under one conventional low-cost molecular method before any Hessian/topology admission.

software.backend_policy: same pinned software versions for every ligand dimer and XY2 seed

electronic_structure.relativity: none in v0.14A; this is a screening limitation, not a high-level admission result
electronic_structure.scf_rescue: none; a failed SCF remains failed

ligand_dimer_prepass.use: the optimized r_YY only seeds the subsequent XY2 geometries; it is not an external fitted bond length

activated_linear_multistart.geometry: Y-X-Y linear with equal X-Y distances

weak_complex_linear_end_on.geometry: X...Y-Y linear; Y-Y fixed only in the seed to the dimer-prepass r_YY

weak_complex_t_shaped.geometry: X approaches the midpoint of Y-Y perpendicular to the dimer axis

raw_outputs_per_relaxation: final Cartesian geometry if optimizer returns
final nuclear-gradient RMS and maximum component
X-Y1, X-Y2, Y-Y distances and Y-X-Y angle
aggregate_without_topology_threshold: relative final energy within each stoichiometry among successful relaxation starts
which seed families converge or fail
whether multiple seeds collapse to numerically similar geometries, reported descriptively without an automatic clustering threshold
explicit_nonclaims: v0.14A does not establish harmonic local minima because no Hessian is run
v0.14A does not replace the frozen v0.8 r2SCAN-3c plus DLPNO-CCSD(T1) high-level admission policy
v0.14A does not assign 3c4e versus VDW topology from geometry alone
seed distances are numerical search starts, not predicted bond lengths
no state-specific method, basis, grid, optimizer, or rescue branch is permitted
no relativistic correction is included in this preliminary screen
anti_fit_rules: Do not remove a seed because its topology is already known from literature.
Do not change a failed seed geometry or SCF settings for one formula only.
Do not interpret the lowest v0.14A electronic energy as a validated ground-state assignment without the later Hessian/admission gates.
Do not use known KrF2 or VDW reference labels to change the common seed scale factors after this preregistration.
